interpretation: This is a descriptive reference, not a yield or production forecast.
Cocoa is a perennial tree crop. Establishment/transplanting replaces an annual sowing date.
ICCO cocoa-year production, USDA area estimates and FAOSTAT calendar-year statistics use different vintages and definitions and must not be silently merged.

headline_reference.season_definition: completed cocoa marketing year, October 2024 to September 2025
headline_reference.production_status: ICCO latest 2024/25 estimate/projection; not a district total
headline_reference.source_difference_note: USDA's early 2025 outlook was 1.8 million t; the later ICCO 2024/25 annual reference is 1.681 million t. The ICCO value is used as the headline and both are retained to expose revision uncertainty.

faostat_calendar_year_reference.note: FAOSTAT calendar-year series with source flags preserved; not directly interchangeable with the 2024/25 cocoa-year references.

crop_cycle.establishment_window: March-April field preparation; transplant at the onset of the main rains
crop_cycle.establishment_note: The national ARS 1000 technical sheet places planting-hole preparation in March-April, at least 15 days before young plants are set out. Exact transplant timing follows local rain onset.

latest_open_regional_breakdown.warning: This is the newest open regional table currently wired into the project, not a 2024/25 regional update.
